note (classes: see delivery_framing.rs): a config write: the commit primitive refuses before or after its rename when the configured path no longer names the locked target or the target was deleted; no call delivery
a config write: the commit primitive's verify refuses when the configured path no longer names the locked target or the target was deleted; it writes nothing; no call delivery
a config write: a v1-only recovery read refuses a journal that is a v2 journal; it writes nothing; no call delivery
a config write: acquiring the config lock refuses while a v2 journal is pending for a v1 caller; it writes nothing; no call delivery
